claims.text: The driver left the rider's message unanswered, and that is the whole of POL-NS-04. The waiting window opened at 13:45:34 and the rider sent MSG-02743-002 at 13:47:02 — inside it — answering the driver's locating message 'here' (sent 13:45:52, read by the rider at 13:46:22); a message acknowledging the driver's stated position and confirming the rider is attending to the pickup is coordinating conduct within limb (a). The driver posted no reply after 13:45:52 and none within the 120 seconds following 13:47:02, and EV-TRIP-02743 records in_app_calls as empty, so limb (b) is satisfied as well. POL-NS-04 therefore exonerates the rider and refunds the 4.50 SGD in full, with no driver compensation payable.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is satisfied on the rider's own track. Every one of the 66 rider fixes in the window is a qualifying fix and every one falls inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius: the furthest is 23.6 m from the pickup pin, the mean 20.0 m and the nearest 16.3 m, with a recorded speed of 0.0 throughout. The rider's device was standing at the pickup point from 13:42:45 — before the driver arrived — until after he cancelled at 13:51:35, so limb (c) is affirmatively met and not undecidable.

The zone class recorded in EV-TRIP-02743 is STANDARD, so POL-NS-02 fixes the arrival radius at 50 m — the tightest radius in the schedule — and the driver's own trace never brings him closer to the pin than 41.4 m: the whole 360 second dwell sits in the outermost 9 m of that radius, while the rider stood 16 to 24 m from the same pin. The rider's account that the driver 'parked a bit away' is corroborated by the driver's own GPS; his statement that he 'was right at the pin' is not, and he never closed the remaining gap to a rider visibly at the pickup point.

POL-NS-01 ties the fee to the rider's failure to appear, which limb (d)'s reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW presupposes, and the evidence contradicts that premise. The rider's device was at the pin — within 23.6 m for every one of the 66 qualifying fixes — from 13:42:45, before the driver's arrival, until after the 13:51:35 cancellation, while the driver held 41.4 m away without moving to her. The absence of a boarding event is explained by the driver cancelling while the rider was still standing at the pin, so the factual foundation on which the RIDER_NO_SHOW fee rests is not made out on this record.

I disclose that EV-ADVIS-02743-01 is impaired: it is MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, and I rely on its absence rather than its content. No traffic advisory covers Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres in this window, so the preconditions of POL-NS-06(i) — a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covering the pickup road — are simply absent. I do not invoke limb (i); the point is that no kerbside restriction, enforcement operation, closure or accident is on this record to explain why the driver held 41.4 m from the pin instead of pulling up to a rider who was at it.

ruling.explanation:
To both parties: this dispute is over the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee charged on trip TRP-02743 after the driver cancelled at 13:51:35 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW. The fee is properly chargeable and the driver is owed SGD 3.60.

Why the fee stands (POL-NS-01, read from EV-TRIP-02743, EV-GPS-02743 and EV-FARE-02743). All four limbs hold: (a) the trip record carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 13:45:32; (b) the GPS trace places him inside the arrival geofence for this STANDARD pickup — 37 qualifying fixes (accuracy within 25 m) inside the 50 m radius, the first at 13:45:32, which is the 'arrived' timestamp POL-NS-01(b) requires; (c) he then held position inside that radius in one continuous run of 360 seconds, from 13:45:32 to 13:51:32 — double the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (trip_record.platform_policy.free_wait_sec); and (d) the record shows no boarding and a driver termination at 13:51:35 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, more than three minutes after the required dwell elapsed at 13:48:32. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee.

To the rider on your points. You are right that the driver stopped a short distance from the pin, and the trace bears you out: his closest approach was 41.4 m. But the policy measures arrival by the arrival radius, and 41.4 m is inside the 50 m STANDARD radius, so POL-NS-03 (wrong-entrance) — which applies only where the driver's stationary fixes are outside the radius — does not apply, and your account that he 'parked a bit away' does not defeat limb (b). Your own rider track is strong (66 qualifying fixes, 16.3–23.6 m from the pin, stationary from 13:42:45 to after the cancellation; POL-NS-04 limb (c) is met), but POL-NS-01 does not make proof of your absence a condition of the fee — limb (d) reads only the reason code and the absence of a boarding event. The clause that protects a rider who is present and trying to coordinate is POL-NS-04, and it needs all three limbs. Limb (a) fails: your only message in the window is 'ok' at 13:47:02, which is an acknowledgement and none of the things limb (a) lists — not your own position, not an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, not a request for the driver's position, and not a statement that you could not see the vehicle. Limb (b) is met (the driver posted no reply within 120 seconds and made no in-app call) and so is limb (c), but with limb (a) unmet the clause cannot refund the fee. Your point about the missing traffic advisory is taken: EV-ADVIS-02743-01 is MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, so no aggregation of separate in-geofence intervals under POL-NS-06(i) is available to either side — but nothing turns on it, because the driver's 360-second run already exceeds the 180-second minimum on its own and there is no shortfall to aggregate.

To the driver on your points. POL-NS-05 does not fire: at 13:45:32 the trace places you 41.4 m from the pin and stationary at 0 km/h, so neither the 300 m trigger nor the 15 km/h trigger fires, your marker is not false, and no false-arrival referral is recorded. Your statement that you were 'right at the pin' is not exactly what the trace shows, but the geofence test is what governs and it is satisfied. POL-NS-07 then fixes your payout at 80 percent of the net fee in force: 80% x SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60, the figure the fare ledger computes (EV-FARE-02743). The anti-farming check does not trip — driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2/123 = 0.016 (below 0.08) — so compensation is paid.

Outcome, confidence and execution. The rider's charge of SGD 4.50 stands unchanged (the fee disposition is NO_ACTION), and because compensation is payable the emitted ruling is DRIVER_COMPENSATION, with amount_sgd carrying the same SGD 3.60 as driver_compensation_sgd (POL-GEN-03). Every artifact carrying the deciding facts — EV-TRIP-02743, EV-GPS-02743 and EV-FARE-02743 — is at weight 1.0, so no discount applies under POL-GEN-02 and the MISSING advisory carried no deciding fact. Confidence 0.90, above the 0.70 floor; no ground under POL-NS-09 applies, so there is no escalation. The monetary effect (SGD 3.60) is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically under POL-GEN-05. This is a provisional ruling made without human review and either party may appeal it under POL-GEN-04.

This is the NO_SHOW_CHARGE on trip TRP-02743 for SGD 4.50, filed by the rider. The charge stands and the driver is paid.

THE FEE. POL-NS-01 requires all four limbs, and each is met on the record. (a) EV-TRIP-02743 carries the driver's own 'arrived' event at 13:45:32. (b) POL-NS-02's GPS test is satisfied: the pickup is STANDARD, so the arrival radius is 50 m, and EV-GPS-02743 places 37 of the driver's 73 fixes inside it, the first at 13:45:32, at or before the marker. (c) The driver held position in one uninterrupted in-geofence run of 360 seconds, 13:45:32 to 13:51:32, against the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (EV-TRIP-02743.platform_policy.free_wait_sec) — twice the required dwell. (d) EV-TRIP-02743 records no boarding and a termination by the driver at 13:51:35 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes the limb recognises, which is after the dwell elapsed at 13:48:32. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces the fee. POL-NS-03 does not apply because the driver's stationary fixes lie inside the arrival radius, not outside it and within 400 m. POL-NS-05 does not fire: the closest approach of 41.4 m is far below the 300 m false-marker trigger and the trace shows him holding position rather than moving at 15 km/h or more. POL-NS-06 yields a surplus of 180 seconds, not a shortfall.

RIDER'S ARGUMENTS. (1) POL-NS-04 does not exonerate the rider. The rider's only message is 'ok' at 13:47:02 in EV-CHAT-02743; that is not the rider's own position, an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that the vehicle could not be seen, so limb (a) fails and the clause cannot operate — all three limbs are required. The driver's 'here' at 13:45:52 and the rider's 'ok' acknowledge contact; they do not locate or coordinate within limb (a)'s words. (2) The rider's limb (c) point is accepted but immaterial: the rider's 66 qualifying fixes do sit 16–24 m from the pin, within the 100 m STANDARD presence radius, but with limb (a) failed POL-NS-04 decides nothing. (3) The rider's claim that the driver never came closer than 41.4 m does not defeat POL-NS-02; that clause's test is the 50 m radius, and fixes at 41.4–50 m are inside it. 'Parked a bit away' is therefore not made out as a wrong-face or wrong-entrance case, and the driver's statement that he was at the pin is corroborated to the extent the radius test requires. (4) The rider's argument that RIDER_NO_SHOW presupposes her absence is rejected: POL-NS-01(d) turns on the recorded reason code and the absence of a boarding event, not on proof the rider was elsewhere. The routes by which a present rider can defeat a RIDER_NO_SHOW charge are POL-NS-04 to POL-NS-06; POL-NS-04's limb (a) is the one that might have applied here and it fails on the message content. (5) The missing advisory is common ground: EV-ADVIS-02743-01 is MISSING, so POL-NS-06(i) aggregation is unavailable to either party — and the driver needs none, his dwell being a single qualifying run.

DRIVER'S COMPENSATION. POL-NS-07 fixes the payout at 80 per cent of the SGD 4.50 net fee = SGD 3.60, the figure EV-FARE-02743 computes in derived.money.driver_compensation. The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below 4, and 2 divided by completed_trips_30d of 123 is 0.016, below 0.08 — the only two profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for this test. Compensation is paid, so the ruling value is DRIVER_COMPENSATION and amount_sgd mirrors driver_compensation_sgd. The rider's charge itself is left in place.

WEIGHT AND CONFIDENCE. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact — the trip record, the GPS trace and the fare breakdown — is at weight_multiplier 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0. EV-ADVIS-02743-01 is MISSING with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT; its absence is citable but carries no fact and nothing here rests on it. No POL-NS-09 trigger applies: confidence is above the 0.70 floor, the artifacts agree, and the anti-farming check is clean.

REFERRALS. None. No clause produces one: there is no false-arrival finding (POL-NS-05(ii)), no driver-conduct review (POL-RD-06(c)), and no billing-integrity item (POL-RD-09(4)).

The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, does not exceed the POL-GEN-05 execution threshold of SGD 8.00 and executes automatically. Either party may appeal under POL-GEN-04.

ruling.explanation:
To the rider: your SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee is not refunded. To the driver: the fee stands and you are paid SGD 3.60 in compensation.

WHY THE FEE STANDS (POL-NS-01). All four conditions hold on this record. (a) EV-TRIP-02743 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 13:45:32. (b) EV-GPS-02743 places him inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius: his closest approach to the pin is 41.4 m and 37 of his 73 fixes are qualifying in-radius fixes, the first at 13:45:32 — the same moment as the marker, not after it. (c) He then held position inside the geofence for one continuous 360-second run (13:45:32 to 13:51:32), twice the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip; so there is a 180-second surplus, not a POL-NS-06 shortfall. (d) There is no boarding event and the trip was terminated by the driver at 13:51:35 under RIDER_NO_SHOW, more than three minutes after the required dwell elapsed at 13:48:32.

On the rider's account that he 'parked a bit away': the geometry is consistent with it in part — he stopped in the outer part of the radius, between 41.4 m and the 50 m boundary — but the policy's arrival test is the radius, not the pin itself, so that does not defeat the fee. His own statement that he 'was right at the pin' is not borne out by the measured 41.4 m; the arrival finding rests on the radius, not on that description.

No displacing clause applies. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at 13:45:32 he was 41.4 m from the pin (well inside the 300 m trigger) and the in-geofence interval is one in which he held position — a vehicle moving at 15 km/h or more could not remain inside a 50 m radius for 360 seconds. So no POL-NS-05(ii) false-arrival referral arises. The traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02743-01 is MISSING, with weight 0.0 and issue MISSING_ARTIFACT, so no POL-NS-06(i) aggregation of separate intervals is available to either side; nothing in this ruling depends on it, and its absence carries no deciding fact.

THE RIDER'S POL-NS-04 ARGUMENT DOES NOT CHANGE THE OUTCOME. I accept limb (c): the rider track in EV-GPS-02743 places the rider's device at the pickup for all 66 qualifying fixes, between 16.3 m and 23.6 m from the pin, throughout the window (comfortably inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius). I also accept limb (b): the driver posted no reply and made no in-app call after the rider's message, and trip_record.in_app_calls is empty. But limb (a) fails, and all three limbs are required. The clause requires a message that is locating or coordinating — the rider's own position, an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that the vehicle cannot be seen. The rider's only message is 'ok' at 13:47:02, which is none of those things; it acknowledges nothing about location and does not make the clause operate. The rider's further argument that POL-NS-01's premise (failure to appear) is contradicted by the rider's own presence is not how the clause is drafted: limb (d) reads the record's reason code and the absence of a boarding event, and both are present. Rider presence enters this category only through POL-NS-04.

COMPENSATION (POL-NS-07). Because POL-NS-01 is satisfied in full and no clause POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displaces it, the driver is paid 80% of the net fee in force: 0.8 x SGD 4.50 = SGD 3.60 (EV-FARE-02743, derived.money.driver_compensation 3.60; the gross figure SGD 6.61 is not used for compensation). The anti-farming check does not trip: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 / 123 = 0.016, below 0.08. Those are the only profile fields this test may use; the parties' ratings, cancellation rates, account ages and lifetime counters are context only and carry no weight.

CONFIDENCE AND EXECUTION. Confidence is 0.90. Every artifact carrying a deciding fact — EV-GPS-02743, EV-TRIP-02743, EV-FARE-02743 and EV-DPROF-02743 — is at weight 1.0, so the confidence cap is 1.0; the only below-weight artifact, the MISSING advisory at 0.0, carries no deciding fact and does not cap the ruling. ruling.explanation:
To both parties: the SGD 4.50 no-show cancellation fee stands and the driver is paid SGD 3.60.

THE CHARGE (POL-NS-01). The fee is chargeable only if all four limbs hold, and they do. (a) EV-TRIP-02743 carries the driver's 'arrived' event at 13:45:32. (b) EV-GPS-02743 shows 37 qualifying in-radius fixes for a STANDARD pickup, and the first in-geofence fix falls at 13:45:32 - at, not after, the marker - with the closest approach 41.4 m, inside the 50 m radius. (c) The driver then held one continuous in-geofence run of 360 seconds, from 13:45:32 to 13:51:32, twice the 180-second free waiting period in force for this trip (EV-TRIP-02743.platform_policy.free_wait_sec). (d) No boarding event is recorded and the trip was terminated by the driver at 13:51:35 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW, one of the three codes limb (d) recognises, more than three minutes after the required dwell elapsed at 13:48:32. No clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06, and no limb of POL-NS-10, displaces this.

THE RIDER'S ARGUMENTS. Your account that the driver 'parked a bit away' does not hold against the measurements: POL-NS-02 fixes the arrival radius at 50 m for a STANDARD zone (EV-TRIP-02743.pickup_zone_class) and the driver's own trace never leaves it, so POL-NS-03 - which applies only where the stationary fixes lie OUTSIDE the radius but within 400 m - is not engaged. The same measurement defeats the argument that the fee's premise fails: POL-NS-01 turns on the driver's arrival and dwell, not on where you stood. Your presence at the pin (66 qualifying fixes, furthest 23.6 m, mean 20.0 m, nearest 16.3 m) is real and I accept it, but rider presence is limb (c) of POL-NS-04, not a condition of POL-NS-01. Your route to exoneration under POL-NS-04 requires all three limbs and limb (a) fails: your only message, 'ok' at 13:47:02, is not your own position, an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, a request for the driver's position, or a statement that you could not see the vehicle - it is a bare acknowledgement, and the clause's enumerated categories do not reach it. Limb (b) (no reply within 120 seconds, in_app_calls empty) and limb (c) (presence) are met, but all three are required, so POL-NS-04 does not operate. POL-NS-06 shows no shortfall - 360 seconds of dwell against a 180-second minimum - and the traffic advisory EV-ADVIS-02743-01 is MISSING with issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight 0.0; both sides cite it only for its absence, limb (i) is unavailable, and it decides nothing here.

THE DRIVER'S ARGUMENTS. The arrival marker is not false under POL-NS-05: at 13:45:32 the trace places you 41.4 m from the pin, under the 300 m trigger, and stationary at 0.0 km/h, under the 15 km/h trigger, so the waiting clock runs from the marker and the full free waiting period was served. POL-NS-07 fixes your payout at 80 percent of the SGD 4.50 net fee, SGD 3.60, as EV-FARE-02743 computes, and the anti-farming check does not trip: EV-DPROF-02743.no_show_terminations_30d is 2 (below 4) and 2 divided by 123 completed trips is 0.016 (below 0.08). These are the only two driver-profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for this test; no other profile field carried weight, and no rider-profile field was used against the rider.

CONFIDENCE AND EXECUTION. Every artifact carrying the deciding facts - EV-TRIP-02743, EV-GPS-02743 and EV-FARE-02743 - is at weight 1.0, so the POL-GEN-02(2) cap is 1.0 and the ruling sits well above the 0.70 escalation floor; neither POL-NS-09 nor POL-GEN-07 is engaged. No clause produces a referral: there was no false arrival marker (POL-NS-05(ii)), no pin-ambiguity goodwill (POL-NS-03(ii)), and the POL-NS-07 anti-farming branch did not fire. The monetary effect, SGD 3.60, is below the SGD 8.00 execution threshold, so it executes automatically, subject to the appeal route in POL-GEN-04.

ledger.claim: The driver left the rider's message unanswered, and that is the whole of POL-NS-04. The waiting window opened at 13:45:34 and the rider sent MSG-02743-002 at 13:47:02 — inside it — answering the driver's locating message 'here' (sent 13:45:52, read by the rider at 13:46:22); a message acknowledging the driver's stated position and confirming the rider is attending to the pickup is coordinating conduct within limb (a). The driver posted no reply after 13:45:52 and none within the 120 seconds following 13:47:02, and EV-TRIP-02743 records in_app_calls as empty, so limb (b) is satisfied as well. POL-NS-04 therefore exonerates the rider and refunds the 4.50 SGD in full, with no driver compensation payable.

Limb (c) of POL-NS-04 is satisfied on the rider's own track. Every one of the 66 rider fixes in the window is a qualifying fix and every one falls inside the 100 m STANDARD rider-presence radius: the furthest is 23.6 m from the pickup pin, the mean 20.0 m and the nearest 16.3 m, with a recorded speed of 0.0 throughout. The rider's device was standing at the pickup point from 13:42:45 — before the driver arrived — until after he cancelled at 13:51:35, so limb (c) is affirmatively met and not undecidable.

The zone class recorded in EV-TRIP-02743 is STANDARD, so POL-NS-02 fixes the arrival radius at 50 m — the tightest radius in the schedule — and the driver's own trace never brings him closer to the pin than 41.4 m: the whole 360 second dwell sits in the outermost 9 m of that radius, while the rider stood 16 to 24 m from the same pin. The rider's account that the driver 'parked a bit away' is corroborated by the driver's own GPS; his statement that he 'was right at the pin' is not, and he never closed the remaining gap to a rider visibly at the pickup point.

POL-NS-01 ties the fee to the rider's failure to appear, which limb (d)'s reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW presupposes, and the evidence contradicts that premise. The rider's device was at the pin — within 23.6 m for every one of the 66 qualifying fixes — from 13:42:45, before the driver's arrival, until after the 13:51:35 cancellation, while the driver held 41.4 m away without moving to her. The absence of a boarding event is explained by the driver cancelling while the rider was still standing at the pin, so the factual foundation on which the RIDER_NO_SHOW fee rests is not made out on this record.

I disclose that EV-ADVIS-02743-01 is impaired: it is MISSING, issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT, weight 0.0, and I rely on its absence rather than its content. No traffic advisory covers Blk 12 Telok Blangah Cres in this window, so the preconditions of POL-NS-06(i) — a present and populated advisory of type KERB_RESTRICTION, ENFORCEMENT, CLOSURE or ACCIDENT covering the pickup road — are simply absent. I do not invoke limb (i); the point is that no kerbside restriction, enforcement operation, closure or accident is on this record to explain why the driver held 41.4 m from the pin instead of pulling up to a rider who was at it.
The trip record carries the driver's own 'arrived' event for this trip, tapped at 13:45:32, so POL-NS-01(a) is satisfied on the platform's own telemetry.

The driver's trace satisfies the POL-NS-02 arrival test for a STANDARD pickup: 37 of his 73 fixes are qualifying in-radius fixes against the 50 m radius for this zone class, and the first qualifying in-geofence fix falls at 13:45:32 - at, not after, the 'arrived' event timestamp - which is what POL-NS-01(b) requires.

The rider's statement that the driver 'parked a bit away' is contradicted by the measured trace: the driver's closest approach to the pickup pin is 41.4 m, inside the 50 m STANDARD arrival radius, and the record never places him outside that radius during the arrival window. Nothing in the geometry supports a wrong-face or wrong-block reading.

The driver then held position inside the geofence for one continuous run of 360 seconds, from 13:45:32 to 13:51:32 - twice the 180 second free waiting period in force for this trip - so POL-NS-01(c) is met, and the POL-NS-06 shortfall computation shows a surplus, not a shortfall, of 180 seconds.

The trip ended with no boarding event and was terminated by the driver at 13:51:35 under reason code RIDER_NO_SHOW - one of the three codes POL-NS-01(d) recognises - which is more than three minutes after the required dwell elapsed at 13:48:32, so limb (d) also holds.

The arrival marker is not a false marker under POL-NS-05: at the 13:45:32 marker the trace places the driver inside the geofence at 41.4 m from the pin and stationary at 0.0 km/h, so neither the 300 m trigger nor the 15 km/h trigger fires, the waiting clock runs from the marker, and the full free waiting period was genuinely served.

POL-NS-04 cannot exonerate the rider. I concede limb (c): the rider's track is present and 66 qualifying fixes sit within 23.6 m of the pin, so the rider was nearby. But limb (a) fails, and all three limbs are required: the rider's only message is 'ok' at 13:47:02, which is not the rider's own position, not an entrance, block, tower or bay identifier, not a request for the driver's position, and not a statement that the vehicle could not be seen. Without limb (a) the clause does not operate, and the driver's message 'here' at 13:45:52 was in any event never answered with any locating information.

No traffic advisory covers this pickup: EV-ADVIS-02743-01 is MISSING, carries issue code MISSING_ARTIFACT and weight_multiplier 0.0, so no POL-NS-06 limb (i) aggregation of separate in-geofence intervals is available to either side. The driver needs none: his qualifying dwell is a single uninterrupted run that already exceeds the minimum, and no party may assert anything against a MISSING artifact.

With POL-NS-01 satisfied in full and no clause from POL-NS-03 to POL-NS-06 displacing it, the SGD 4.50 cancellation fee stands as charged - NO_ACTION on the fee, which on this rider-filed dispute leaves the present payment state intact - and POL-NS-07 fixes the driver's payout at 80 percent of that net fee, SGD 3.60, as the fare ledger computes.

The POL-NS-07 anti-farming check does not trip and compensation cannot be withheld: driver_profile.no_show_terminations_30d is 2, below the threshold of 4, and 2 divided by driver_profile.completed_trips_30d of 123 is 0.016, below the required 0.08. These are the only two profile fields POL-GEN-01 permits for this test, and no other field on the driver profile carries any weight here.
